lucas: Bringing up saffron-20b on runtime v2 — hitting weird token misalignment when using rope_v2 scaling. Short repro attached, can someone sanity-check? :thinking:

mira: Can you paste the smallest possible repro and which kernel/hw you saw it on?

lucas: repro below (A100, driver 525). Notice prediction shift after ~512 tokens.
```python
# minimal reproduce
from redwood_runtime import Client
client = Client(model='saffron-20b', runtime='v2')
ctx = ' '.join(['word']*520)
resp = client.generate(ctx, max_new_tokens=20, use_rope='v2')
print(resp.tokens[510:540])
# observed: tokens are off-by-one starting at 512
```

toni: hmm looks like a RoPE phase wrap issue. Did you try legacy scaling? `use_rope='v1'` or `rope_scale=1.0`?

lucas: Yup. With v1 the shift disappears. With v2 scaling enabled: mismatch. Also noticed kv-cache dump length differs between v1/v2. Example log: `kv.len=513 vs 512` after the same request.

kevin: Quant experiments note: we saw similar effects when doing asymmetric 4-bit quant on rotary weights — rounding changed high-freq phase. Might be a quantization-induced RoPE drift. Did you run int4/int8 comparisons?

lucas: ran fp16 vs int8-llm.int8() quick test — both show the drift but int4 amplifies it. So maybe both a kernel ordering and quant rounding issue.

mira: Can you run `bench_onboard.sh --rope-debug --dump-kv` and attach the dump? I'll diff the kv tensors. Also add `--retain-prefix-cache` to rule out prefix eviction bug.

lucas: kicked off `bench_onboard.sh`. CI id: ci/eng-ml/1723 — includes rope debug and kv dumps.

ci-bot: Test run ci/eng-ml/1723 started by lucas. Stages: setup -> build -> smoke -> rope-debug. Current: rope-debug running.

toni: Another idea: our rotary implementation assumes even sequence lengths for the in-place rotate kernel. If seq%64 != 0 we might be falling back to a slower path that shifts an index. Check `rotary_kernel_impl.h` for the fallback path.

kevin: I can reproduce locally on RTX6000 with a smaller seq (320) if I force `kv_stride=256`. Will try to capture assembly diffs for the kernel variants.

mira: Action items: 1) lucas attach kv dumps + exact model checkpoint hash, 2) kevin run assembly diff and quant compare, 3) toni audit fallback path in rotary kernels. I'll follow up with a small patch to toggle rope scaling at runtime for quick A/B. :eyes:

lucas: attaching checkpoint sha: sha256:4b8d...ef12 and link to dump: s3://redwood-onboard/saffron-20b/ci-1723/kv-dumps.zip

ci-bot: Test run ci/eng-ml/1723 rope-debug finished: FAILED (regression detected). Logs: s3://redwood-onboard/saffron-20b/ci-1723/logs.txt

mira: ok thanks — I'll diff and report back. If we confirm it's kernel fallback + quant rounding interacting we should add a unit test with seq=512/513 to catch in CI.

lucas: adding a ticket in eng-ml backlog and will pin saffron-20b onboarding until root cause identified. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
